features.summary: Exact variant key count, range, white/black pattern and geometry: 73 keys, E1-E7 (MIDI 28-100), 43 white / 30 black, black keys 0.61 of white height, black width 0.62 of white, derived from the MIDI range and re-verified against the variant.
Six ordered sections at the photo-measured 14/20/8.5/12.5/25/20 widths, 54/46 deck/keybed split, one continuous chassis with the two bands as siblings inside it.

167 addressable controls with stable dotted IDs; per-section landmarks present; Program and Synth are the only primary OLED locations, with the synth OLED at 0.40 of its section width and the program band carrying one display.
Pointer down/up/cancel, glissando across keys, independent multi-touch, mapped computer keyboard with repeat suppression and blur cleanup, and unmount cleanup, all through one note lifecycle.

Every visible control moves or presses and writes only to the normalized presentation store; with a recording engine injected, operating any panel control starts no audio, ends no voice and never starts the engine.
Accessible names, roles (slider/switch/button/radiogroup), values, keyboard operation and visible focus for all 167 controls, plus named section landmarks and labeled displays.
Note on/off through one lifecycle, repeated press suppression, overlapping re-strike with a new attack, release, all-notes-off with a recorded reason, and node counts returning to baseline.

Pointer, independent multi-touch, mapped computer keyboard with repeat suppression, MIDI note/velocity and sustain CC64, and truthful denied/unsupported/disconnected MIDI states that leave the keybed playable.

Sustain transitions (pedal-down hold, pedal-up damping, held-through-pedal-lift notes, independent pedal owners), concurrent voices, deterministic oldest-first voice stealing at the cap, and velocity carried into every voice.

Truthful idle/loading/ready/suspended/error/fallback status surfaced in the Program display, every voice stopped on blur, MIDI disconnect and unmount, and the Web Audio graph reclaiming its nodes while keeping one master path.

One continuous chassis, no marketing hero above it, no reference photograph as background, a complete 73-key keybed inside its box, no horizontal scroll container, and the front rail attached to the keybed, verified structurally at both canonical viewports.
